claims.assertion: Athena describes higher selves as connected, nested beings or aspects that may influence groups as a collective; they have broader but still limited perspectives and may not share an incarnate person’s priorities.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says conscious avatar wishes can carry less weight in the higher self’s view.

claims.assertion: Athena says accidents may also be provoked by lower-astral entities seeking suffering, with a person’s vibration affecting whether they align.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as an additional factor, not a complete explanation.
